---
title: "Templates"
description: "A collection of Quarto + Typst templates for academic writing, reports, presentations, and administration."
---

::: {.content-container}

A collection of [Quarto](https://quarto.org) + [Typst](https://typst.app) templates I use day-to-day and have cleaned up for public use. Each one installs as a Quarto extension via a single command, then set the `format:` field in your `.qmd` and go.

[{{< fa brands github >}} All templates on GitHub](https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates){.btn-pub}

## Research & publishing

:::: {.template-grid}

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/working-paper">
  ![](/images/templates/working-paper.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Working paper template thumbnail"}
</a>
### working-paper
Double-spaced manuscript with title page, abstract, keywords, ORCID footnote affiliations, and a bibliography with CSL support.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/cover-letter">
  ![](/images/templates/cover-letter.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Cover letter template thumbnail"}
</a>
### cover-letter
Journal submission cover letter with letterhead-style sender block, recipient, and auto-formatted date.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/peer-review-memo">
  ![](/images/templates/peer-review-memo.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Peer review memo template thumbnail"}
</a>
### peer-review-memo
Structured memo for journal peer reviews — manuscript metadata header, summary, major and minor comments.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/review-response">
  ![](/images/templates/review-response.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Review response template thumbnail"}
</a>
### review-response
Point-by-point response to reviewers with gray reviewer-comment blocks and styled "Response:" replies.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/nsf-proposal">
  ![](/images/templates/nsf-proposal.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="NSF proposal template thumbnail"}
</a>
### nsf-proposal
PAPPG-compliant multi-document NSF proposal with a Makefile build system and section-by-section PDFs matching Research.gov upload order.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/cv">
  ![](/images/templates/cv.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="CV template thumbnail"}
</a>
### cv
Academic CV with icon-decorated contact header (Font Awesome + academicons), clean section headers, and entry helpers for employment, publications, teaching, and service.
:::

## Communications

:::: {.template-grid}

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/report">
  ![](/images/templates/report.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Report template thumbnail"}
</a>
### report
Formal project or grant report with a cover page, running header and footer, accent-colored block headings, and note / tip / important / warning callouts.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/policy-brief">
  ![](/images/templates/policy-brief.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Policy brief template thumbnail"}
</a>
### policy-brief
Short skim-friendly brief with a colored banner, key-findings box, pull-quote sidebar, recommendations block, and a citation footer.
:::

::: {.template-card}
<a href="https://github.com/cwimpy/typst-templates/tree/main/poster">
  ![](/images/templates/poster.png){.template-thumb fig-alt="Conference poster template thumbnail"}
</a>
### poster
A0 landscape conference poster with title banner, hero pull-quote, stat cards, numbered chips, and optional footer logos.
:::
